1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de tronco corto, de pequeña copa redonda, hojas oblongas, lanceoladas, inflorescencia axilar y flores de color blanco. Apocynaceae Echites biflora.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with a short trunk, small rounded crown, oblong lanceolate leaves, axillary inflorescence and white flowers. Apocynaceae Echites biflora.
